description.value:
As a bonus action, you can spend one minute in a balanced stance. As part of that bonus action, and again as a bonus action on each later turn, whenever you use your action to cast a force power you may also make one melee weapon attack. For the stance's duration, you may also use your Wisdom or Charisma modifier in place of Strength or Dexterity for both the attack and damage rolls of your melee weapon attacks, provided you use the same modifier for both rolls.

The stance ends early if you're incapacitated or killed. You must finish a long rest before using this feature again.
